business_scope.primary_industry_name: Operating and Financial Leasing of Turbofan Aircraft Engines

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (MCAA) — Samoa is a Party; the Convention is in force and provides government-only exchange-of-information channels relevant to UBO verification and tax transparency.

Agreement between Samoa and the United States to Improve International Tax Compliance and Implement FATCA (Model 1 Intergovernmental Agreement) — in force; establishes automatic exchange of financial account information with the IRS.
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus) — regional trade and investment facilitation framework in force for Samoa.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Samoa International Companies Act 1987, as amended to 30 June 2024, ss. 3-5 (incorporation), s. 14 (statutory registered office in Samoa), and associated International Companies (Registered Agents) Regulations requiring a licensed Samoa registered agent; Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (Samoa), ss. 6-13 (customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, record-keeping and suspicious transaction reporting); Financial Intelligence Unit Act 1998 (Samoa), as amended, vesting supervisory powers in the Financial Intelligence Unit with lawful access to UBO records; AML/CFT supervision is jointly administered by the Financial Intelligence Unit and the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: People's Republic of China Notary Public Office (公证处)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial Ownership Certificate and Source of Funds Declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ultimate beneficial owner and licensed Samoa registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and Incumbency of the ultimate corporate shareholder, if any
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or licensed corporate services provider of the originating jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Chinese-language charter and certified English translation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: People's Republic of China Notary Public Office (公证处) and corporate legal counsel

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and banker's confirmation of account relationship for the escrow and Swift-wire payment rails

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, shareholders, authorized signatories and material lessee-counterparties against the United Nations Security Council consolidated list, the U.S. OFAC SDN list, the EU consolidated sanctions list, and Samoa domestic sanctions. Foreign and domestic PEPs are subject to enhanced due diligence, including senior-management approval of the customer relationship, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds certification, and the implementation of heightened ongoing monitoring applicable to the Medium_Risk_Enhanced aviation-leasing profile; any sanctions, PEP, or adverse-media hit must be escalated to the licensed registered agent's AML Compliance Officer and the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit as required.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) — Companies and Intellectual Property Registry, International Companies Division; name-clearance applications are lodged exclusively through licensed Samoa registered agents via the MCIL corporate e-services portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered legal name must be expressed in English using Latin script; a Chinese-character name may be adopted solely as an additional authorized secondary name. Where the International Company adopts a fully Chinese-language charter, a notarized English translation of the charter and a romanized transliteration of the Chinese name must be filed with the licensed registered agent; the public registry index is maintained exclusively in romanized Latin script.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any token suggesting patronage, sponsorship, or connection with the Government of Samoa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A reserved International Company name may be renewed once by a written pre-expiry application to the Registrar for a further period not exceeding 30 days. Upon rejection, the applicant must file a written reconsideration request with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 working days of the notice of rejection; the Registrar must issue a decision within 10 working days. A further administrative appeal lies to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour, followed by judicial review before the Supreme Court of Samoa. Where rejection is based on a prohibited token, the applicant must obtain prior written consent from the Reserve Bank of Samoa or the relevant Ministerial authority, as applicable, before re-submitting the name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible in substance for the lessor and holding entity: the company may administer the engine dry-leasing portfolio and execute transactions remotely, but it must at all times maintain a statutory registered office at the licensed registered agent's physical premises in Apia open during normal business hours. A pure virtual-address arrangement unattached to a licensed Samoa registered agent is not permissible.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 20% annualized probability of an unannounced physical inspection of the registered office and registered agent facility, reflecting the Medium_Risk_Enhanced AML tier, the aviation-asset lease provenance requirements, and the regulatory posture of the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit; document-only supervision and exchange-of-information requests are expected at a materially higher frequency.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, sections 4-12 (Incorporation), 26-31 (Memorandum and Articles), 60-68 (Directors and Officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Companies Registration Unit, Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form 1) together with the Charter and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum issued or paid-up capital; subscriber shares may be issued partly or fully paid; no statutory escrow account or capital deposit requirement for International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the subscribers hereby ratify and adopt the Charter and Articles of Association of the Company as filed with the Samoa International Finance Authority; (2) That 1,000 ordinary shares of US$1.00 each be issued to the initial subscriber at par, credited as fully paid, with no call or encumbrance; (3) That the registered office be fixed at the office of the licensed international company service provider in Apia, Samoa, and the Corporate Secretary be authorized to file the Registered Office Notification; (4) That [Name] be appointed sole Director and [Name] be appointed Corporate Secretary of the Company; (5) That the Director be and is hereby empowered to open escrow and wire-transfer banking arrangements, execute lease agreements, and take all ancillary steps.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) — Name Reservation Desk (through a licensed international company service provider)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name clearance application through a licensed SIFA agent. The proposed company name must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name and must include 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' as the final word. SIFA performs a conflict search and issues a name reservation validity period of 30 days.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form signed by the proposed subscriber
Consent letter from the licensed international company service provider
Agent engagement and acceptance letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or queried, the agent must promptly file an alternative name reservation application; the 30-day validity restarts upon approval of the substitute name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Charter and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Samoan attorney or international company service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Charter and Articles in English in a form compliant with the International Companies Act 1987. The Charter must state the proposed name, capital structure, registered office provisions, and subscriber details. Execute the documents before a witness; all signatures must be notarially witnessed or lawfully apostilled if executed outside Samoa.
required_dossiers: Charter and Articles of Association (draft)
Subscriber identity evidence (notarized passport copy)
Certificate of character or bank reference letter
Registered office consent confirmation from the service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar raises drafting deficiencies, execute a supplementary amendment or re-executed Charter; no re-filing fee is charged for ministerial corrections within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) — Companies Registration Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Charter, Articles, and Form 1 application via the licensed agent. Pay the prescribed filing fee remitted by electronic transfer to SIFA. The application must declare the registered office in Samoa, the first director(s), the first secretary, and the subscriber shareholding. SIFA may require a notarized specimen signature card for the authorized director.
required_dossiers: Form 1 Application for Incorporation
Charter and Articles of Association (original or certified copy)
Director and shareholder consent forms
Notarized passport and proof of residential address for each officer
Registered office consent and agent acceptance letter
Bank references and KYC/AML onboarding pack
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIFA issues a requisition or query, submit a written response with corrected documentation through the agent within 14 days; failure to cure with proper filing will result in withdrawal, and the filing fee may be credited to a new application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) — Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon clearance of all filed instruments, SIFA registers the company in the International Companies Register and issues a Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company's number and date of incorporation. The agent collects the certificate and certified copy of the Charter.
required_dossiers: Approved Charter and Articles of Association
Acknowledgment of incorporation with SIFA date-stamp
Proof of payment of incorporation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a clerical error or is delayed, request written confirmation and a corrected certificate under the Registrar's rectification power; statutory rectification is completed without fresh incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed international company service provider and licensed Samoan bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Effect post-incorporation administrative steps: hold and minute the first board resolution; file the Registered Office and Corporate Secretary notifications with SIFA; open a corporate bank account with escrow and wire-transfer capabilities; and apply for a letter of good standing for tax exemption confirmation.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Charter
First board resolution minutes
Director and officer identification dossier
Bank account application forms (corporate KYC pack)
SIFA annual fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or agent queries the beneficial ownership structure, provide a certified corporate register extract and a formal declaration confirming the economic owner; re-submit the corrected pack without delay.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) — Commerce and Industry Division; not applicable to a pure asset-leasing vehicle
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating or manufacturing license required; the company is not engaged in physical goods production, repair, or maintenance in Samoa. Any aviation leasing activity is governed by contractual law and the terms of the underlying aircraft engine lease.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA) of the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment, Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the venture performs no construction, land modification, manufacturing, or waste-generating activity in Samoa; office-only occupation is outside the EIA trigger thresholds under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable — no wastewater discharges, stack emissions, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste streams arise from administrative aircraft asset leasing; only general office waste handling obligations under the Waste Management Act 2010 apply

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety and structural clearance are not separately mandated for a registered-office-only International Company; the licensed service provider's premises must maintain a valid occupancy certificate and fire extinguisher compliance. If the company opens a physical administrative office in Apia, it must obtain an Occupation Permit from the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure and adhere to the Samoa Occupational Safety and Health Act 2002 for general office workplace safety.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MfR), Government of Samoa, Apia; official e-services and filing portal: Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS) — https://www.mfr.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) registered under Samoa's International Companies Act 1987 is not automatically issued a Samoan TIN. To obtain statutory VAT/TIN identification, the foreign-owned IC applies to the Ministry for Revenue on the prescribed TIN application form (processed through the ITAS e-portal or in paper at the Apia office), attaching the Registrar-issued Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, registered agent consent letter, director and beneficial owner passports, and proof of the registered office in Apia. The MfR issues a unique taxpayer identification and VAGST registration number; alternatively, the IC obtains from the Registrar of International Companies a Certificate of Tax Exemption evidencing that no Samoan tax registration is required for purely offshore activities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — the Samoa International Company (IC) is a statutorily ring-fenced exempt vehicle under the International Companies Act 1987; it is exempt from income tax, stamp duty, corporate filing duties, and foreign exchange controls, and only a Samoan fixed place of business engaged in local-source commercial activity could attract territorial assessment under the Income Tax Act 2012.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa does not maintain a 'check-the-box' or hybrid-mismatch election. The only relevant statutory mechanisms are (i) voluntary VAGST registration below the monetary threshold under the Goods and Services Tax Act 1992, and (ii) the IC's statutory exemption certificate regime, which is not elective once the International Companies Act 1987 conditions are satisfied. No pass-through election is available to an International Company.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST), Goods and Services Tax Act 1992 (as amended)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 (Samoa Tala) taxable turnover in any 12-month period; voluntary registration is available to exporters and international services providers below the threshold; a foreign lessor with no Samoan fixed establishment and no local taxable activity remains outside the VAGST net.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa has no real-time e-invoicing clearance, fiscal stamping, or mandatory digital API clearance regime. The MfR relies on periodic VAGST returns filed electronically through ITAS; a registered supplier must issue a tax invoice containing prescribed particulars (supplier name and registration number, invoice date, description and quantity, consideration, and VAGST shown separately) and must retain export evidence for audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The dry lease of an aircraft engine qualifies for the 0% VAGST rate only where the engine is supplied to, and continuously used by, a non-resident lessee outside Samoa and the lease constitutes an export of goods or an internationally connected service under the Goods and Services Tax Act 1992. The IC must demonstrate that the engine was exported from Samoa or was never imported into Samoa, that the commercial benefit of the lease is enjoyed wholly offshore, that the lessee is not a resident of Samoa, and that consideration is received in foreign currency. For a tax-exempt IC with no VAGST registration, no output tax arises and the gross lease rentals remain outside the Samoan indirect tax base.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CusDec) processed by the Customs Division of the Ministry for Revenue, or an approved customs transshipment/export endorsement evidencing physical export of the engine from Samoa
Bill of Lading or Master Air Waybill and related transport documents evidencing dispatch of the engine to the non-resident lessee
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103/MT202 bank records evidencing receipt of the foreign-currency lease rental in a Samoan or offshore IC account
Executed dry-lease agreement, lease schedule, and engine log book or serial-number documentation identifying the non-resident lessee and offshore user
Zero-rated VAGST tax invoice issued with all prescribed particulars, together with a certificate of non-residence for the lessee
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The MfR may conduct export-substantiation audits within the statutory limitation period. If the required customs, transport, lease, and foreign-exchange documentation cannot be produced, the zero-rated supply will be recharacterized as a local taxable supply at 15% VAGST, with retrospective clawback assessment, statutory late-payment and late-filing penalties, and default interest under the Goods and Services Tax Act 1992 and the Tax Administration Act 2012. Knowingly false zero-rating declarations constitute a criminal offense punishable by fine and/or imprisonment, and directors, beneficial owners, and the IC's registered agent may be subject to joint and several liability. Breach of the International Companies Act 1987 conditions can additionally trigger forfeiture of the IC's tax-exempt status.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), acting under the Exchange Control Act 1976, the Exchange Control Regulations 1979, the Financial Institutions Act 2002, and the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Act 2007.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoa tala (WST) is convertible for current account payments subject to CBS notification and, in some cases, exchange control approval. Capital account transfers, including inbound equity injection and outward investment, require prior CBS exchange control authorization. An International Company (IC) may lawfully maintain and settle obligations in foreign currency, which materially reduces conversion friction. Dividends and profit remittances to non-residents are permitted once funded from genuinely audited profits and after any domestic tax claim is settled or waived; in practice the key hurdles are KYC/AML clearance, bank-level source-of-funds verification, and CBS notification above prescribed thresholds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Samoa does not operate a general surrender requirement for export proceeds. Exporters of goods and services must declare the transaction and ensure that receivables are collected through an authorized dealer within the statutory period, ordinarily not exceeding 180 days from shipment or performance. For cross-border engine dry-leasing income, lease invoices and SWIFT remittances are treated as export earnings; the IC may retain the foreign-currency proceeds in an approved foreign-currency account with a licensed bank, avoiding mandatory conversion into WST. Non-compliance with receipt timelines attracts CBS penalties and may trigger enhanced bank review of the underlying leasing agreement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Samoa has no dedicated electronic money institution (EMI) licensing framework. Offshore fintech EMIs and digital banks cannot independently hold Samoa bank-licensed accounts or access local clearing and settlement rails. A foreign EMI may only operate as an unregulated payment facilitator, routing funds through a sanctioned correspondent bank; this structure exposes the IC to heightened AML scrutiny and reputational risk. A Samoa IC should rely on a licensed local commercial bank with robust SWIFT connectivity rather than an offshore EMI for treasury-critical payments.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is permitted only where the bank's AML/CFT risk rating supports virtual identification and the bank has an approved remote-KYC procedure. In practice, Samoa banks require at least one director, a company secretary, or a licensed trustee/nominee with pre-verified KYC to be interviewed, either physically at the Samoa branch or through a recorded video call. For an aircraft-engine dry-leasing IC with non-resident directors and no domestic substance, banks commonly impose an additional in-person meeting with the beneficial owner or a formal introduction from a regulated Samoan legal adviser.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company with no local economic substance other than registered office
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation and memorandum/articles; current register of directors and shareholders; beneficial ownership declaration under the International Companies Act; group organizational chart; notarized passports of all directors and shareholders; professional reference from counsel or a licensed trustee; current Certificate of Good Standing; CRS/FATCA registration proof and economic substance filing, if applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value cross-border aviation leasing with no prior banking relationship
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed dry-leasing agreement; engine manufacturer and model specification sheet; engine serial number, hours, cycles, and maintenance log; current airworthiness and maintenance release documentation; independent asset valuation report; aviation insurance certificate with loss-payee clause; charterer/end-user KYB profile and underlying utilization summary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident board and shareholders domiciled in multiple jurisdictions of concern
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid passport copies and proof of residential address for each authorized signatory; detailed CV and professional history; source-of-wealth statements and latest bank account statements; adverse-media check results; tax identification numbers of all jurisdictions; global ultimate beneficial ownership attestation; reference letter from a regulated bank or law firm in the director's home jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Escrow account usage with discretionary third-party disbursement instructions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Duly signed escrow agreement; written standing settlement instructions on bank letterhead; list of all intended payees with corporate KYC and UBO identification; invoice and lease-rental schedule; purpose codes for each wire transfer; internal sanctions-screening confirmation and periodic transaction justification reports.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity or shareholder loan funding is transmitted by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's bank to the Samoa IC's operational account at a licensed bank. The wire instruction must include the IC name, the unique corporate identifier, the purpose reference 'WS_IC_ISIC_5223_01', and a clear balance-of-payments purpose code: for equity use 'Equity capital other than reinvestment of earnings'; for shareholder loans use 'Other investment – loans'. When the remittance exceeds the CBS notification threshold, the Samoa bank must be given a signed declaration form, evidence of source of funds, a corporate resolution authorizing the injection, and either the escrow agreement or the aircraft-engine lease agreement where the injection supports lease pre-funding. WST conversion, if any, is executed by the authorized dealer at the prevailing market exchange rate and recorded on the authorized dealer transaction form.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Treasury disbursements for engine lease settlements, security deposits, maintenance reserves, and third-party payments are primarily cleared via SWIFT MT103 using the IC's directly held correspondent account at the tier-1 bank. Where funds are moved between internal treasury accounts, SWIFT MT202 is used. Commercial letters of credit are not standard for dry-lease rent; however, a standby letter of credit (SWIFT MT760) is permissible when the lessee or lessor requires a security instrument. Escrow release triggers require the presentation of an execution letter, invoice, maintenance receipt, engine log confirmation, and the mutual release instruction. All outbound payments must carry a valid purpose code, match the lease schedule, and be supported by an corresponding export/lease invoice to remain compliant with exchange control and bank AML screening.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward foreign exchange contracts with an authorized dealer in Samoa, limited to hedged commercial exposure and approved by CBS if the notional amount exceeds threshold.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing the WST/USD rate, executed with a licensed offshore bank or an approved global FX provider, subject to CBS and bank documentation requirements.
Cross-currency swaps with a CBS-licensed bank, restricted to hedging actual lease receivables or payables and requiring formal CBS exchange control approval.
FX options purchased from an authorized dealer, used only to protect against adverse currency moves and supported by genuine underlying trade flows.
Natural-interest offsets through matched multi-currency accounts, permitted where the IC holds USD income and USD expenditure in a consolidated foreign-currency treasury ledger.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (statutory declaration of registered share capital, members, directors, and registered office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Services Centre (SIFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file the annual return for more than 12 months triggers a notice of intended strike-off; the company may be dissolved unless reinstatement is subsequently approved by the Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual government license fee (company franchise fee for the International Company registration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Services Centre (SIFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable on the anniversary date of incorporation; a 30-day grace period is allowed before delinquency applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late payment penalty of 10% of the annual fee applies after the 30-day grace period; continued non-payment beyond 6 months leads to administrative strike-off from the Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered office and registered agent annual confirmation (annual re-engagement of in-country registered agent and office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies via the licensed registered agent in Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Contemporaneously with the annual return filing deadline (within 90 days after each incorporation anniversary)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Loss of registered office or agent is a notification event; if no agent is appointed within 60 days, the Registrar may strike off the International Company.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to a standard International Company engaged in aircraft engine dry leasing, unless the company holds a financial services, banking, or insurance license, or is required by a shareholder resolution or a loan agreement; regulated financial institutions are subject to mandatory annual audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as the acceptable accounting framework for International Companies that voluntarily prepare audited financial statements; minimal statutory record-keeping requirements otherwise permit simple cash-basis internal records.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must maintain a beneficial ownership register. An annual confirmation of beneficial ownership is required at each anniversary date, stating any changes in ultimate beneficial ownership, shareholding percentage, or control during the preceding year. The confirmation remains confidential with the registered agent and is not publicly filed, but must be produced to the SIFSC on demand.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (Income Tax Act 2019, Samoa Revenue Authority). International Company (IC): 0% effective rate - full exemption from income tax, withholding tax, capital gains, stamp duty and estate duty on all foreign-source income under s.183(1) International Companies Act 1987 (as amended).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IC offshore exemption: 0% on aircraft engine lease rentals, interest, royalties, dividends and capital gains derived outside Samoa; no VAT registration on offshore engine leases; no thin-capitalization or interest restriction in Samoa; exemption conditional on the IC carrying on no business with the public within Samoa and holding no Samoan real property.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (Form AR-IC, s.209 International Companies Act 1987) - lodged with the Registrar of International Companies via the licensed registered agent or the SIFA e-filing portal. No Samoa income tax return is required because the IC is exempt from income tax.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 20 days after the anniversary of incorporation; each year the IC must file despite having zero taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name, registration number, date and place of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exact name in Latin script as on the certificate; provide the company number without punctuation errors

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office in Apia, Samoa; not a post office box
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Address must be the licensed CSP office in Samoa; foreign shareholder address cannot be substituted

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, SIFA license number and contact details of the licensed company service provider
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Agent must be a Samoa-licensed CSP; the foreign parent or its counsel cannot act as agent

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full name, nationality, residential address and passport number of each director
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; nominee status must be disclosed; at least one director should be available for SIFA correspondence

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part E - Shareholders and Share Capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued shares by class, par value, total issued capital, names and addresses of all members
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the ultimate beneficial owner on the confidential register; bearer shares no longer permitted on new issues

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declarations of compliance with the ICA 1987, solvency, and confirmation that no business was carried on with the public in Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Sign by a Samoa-resident director or the registered agent; a false declaration is a criminal offense

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Dated signature of director, secretary, or registered agent with capacity stated
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Signatory must hold authority under the constitutional documents; signed original retained at the registered office in Apia

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Default fine for late filing plus daily surcharge on continued default; failure to file for two consecutive years results in administrative strike-off and forfeiture of the IC's assets to the Registrar; strike-off triggers adverse flags with foreign tax authorities and restricts directors' future roles.
